system.description: A practical, intuitive understanding of how things work - mechanical systems, tools, vehicles, common electronics, and the physical infrastructure of daily life. Mechanics covers hotwiring a van, rigging a generator, repairing a water pump, bypassing an electronic lock with the right tools, and diagnosing why the heating system has stopped working. It is hands-on applied knowledge. For theoretical or highly specialist understanding, see Academic.
system.overcome: Use Mechanics to repair or operate a mechanical or electrical system, diagnose a fault and work out a fix, drive or operate a vehicle in normal conditions, or bypass a mechanical or low-level electronic security measure.
system.caa: Use Mechanics to identify a fault that can be exploited - an engine that could be quietly sabotaged, a lock that's already compromised, a building whose systems could be rigged in your favour. Create aspects like Fuel Line Disconnected, Emergency Exit Unlocked, or Generator on a Timer.
system.attack: Sabotage or activate a conveniently placed piece of machinery. Likely single-use.
system.defend: Similar to Attack, but a little harder to justify. However if it fits the fiction, then it's up to the GM.
